results.description: api/ root must not contain loose .rs files or mixed-layout directories — only mod.rs at root; no flat traits/types/error/ dirs when domain-grouped layout (api/<domain>/traits/) is active
Source files must not suppress the dead_code lint via #[allow(dead_code)]
saf/ pub fn return types must be declared in api/types/ (when spi/ is absent)
saf/ methods must not be thin wrappers — a saf/ method whose entire body delegates to a free function or another method adds no value and signals incomplete consolidation
api/ files and types must not use the Default* prefix — Default* names signal a concrete implementation variant that belongs in core/, not in the contract layer
core/ (L2) struct names must not end with Impl — use the Default* prefix (or Local*, Remote*, InMemory*, Noop*, <Technology>*) to name concrete implementation variants
